_comment: Demo seed for virtual fences. Copy to the path in config.yaml geofence.store (default data/fences.json) before starting the server, or draw fences from the dashboard FENCES panel (which rewrites that file). Coordinates are normalised 0..1 of each camera's view; a polygon needs >=3 points, a line needs 2+ (each consecutive pair is a tripwire segment, so a bent fence line is one fence). direction is line-only: a2b | b2a | both. targets: any | person | vehicle.
